duration.description: Duration for how long in the past should log be analyzed.

tag.description: '<tenant>:<tag>' to be used as a filter.

action.description: '<type>.<action>' to be used as a filter.

group.description: Grouping must be done by ID in order to reconstruct the trees.

order.description: The default ordering of actions within a parent is by start time.

splitIo.description: If true then will also produce sql and kv times.

limit.description: Limit for results is increased to allow trees to be built completely.

maxDepth.description: Option to limit the depth of the trees built.

ignoreUnrooted.description:
Ignore actions within the query period that are parented by an action not found within the query period.
If false, unrooted actions within the query period end up being placed into a final placeholder tree labeled
"(unrooted)".

title:
Specifications for LogProfiler.stacks action. The width of each node in the tree is calculated based on the
{@link #widthStat} (usually execution time) and ordered by action start time.
name: LogProfileStacksSpec
